thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: api-gateway (edge/gateway) error rate spike detected in us-east-1 — 502/504s at 14.8% over 5m, latency p95 ~ 1200ms. Paging on-call.

sre_alex: acked. i'm on pager. pulling ingress metrics and top-k upstreams now.

platform_oncall: switching to emergency mitigation: preparing to enable regional fallback to eu-west cluster (non-disruptive if we do traffic cutover). will post cmd.

support_emily: seeing multiple customer reports for checkout failures, a few paying customers hit. volume ~2% of normal but high error concentration. adding a note to status page draft.

eng_jordan: any recent deploys on gateway or auth? i saw a small routing config rollout 30m ago.

sre_alex: no app deploys in last 45m per deploy-bot. routing config rollout completed 28m ago though — checking rollout records.

ml_rachael: looking at KV cache logs — lots of upstream 504s to inference-redis cluster? could be connection pool exhaustion.

sre_alex: top upstream errors: backend-group-a (ingress->mux) returning 504 connection timeout, rate spiking on new persistent connections. stack traces show conn resets.

platform_oncall: mitigation plan:
1) enable circuit-breaker on gateway to short-circuit backends with >30% errors
2) scale backend-group-a by +3 instances
3) enable traffic steering to eu-west for new sessions

I'll run 1 and 2 now.

sre_alex: running:
```
# enable circuit breaker
redwoodctl gateway set-cb --env us-east-1 --group backend-group-a --threshold 0.3
# scale up
kubectl scale deployment backend-group-a --replicas=8 -n production
```

platform_oncall: circuit breaker enabled. scaling request accepted, pods launching.

eng_jordan: i'm pausing the routing config rollout (flag: rollout-route-2026-03) just in case.

sre_alex: paused rollout. metrics after cb: within 2min, error rate dropped to 7.2% (still high), p95 down to 900ms.

support_emily: updating customers in the thread: "We're investigating elevated API errors impacting checkout; mitigation in progress — some traffic may be routed to fallback region. We'll post ETA shortly." :hourglass_flowing_sand:

ml_rachael: connection pool metrics show pool exhaustion on inference-redis shards 7/8 — new connections piling up. suggest temporarily increasing max connections and enabling connection re-use in gateway config.

platform_oncall: doing connection param tweak now.

sre_alex: pushed gateway config change to reduce new connection churn:
```
gateway.conn.max_idle=500
gateway.conn.keepalive=60s
```

sre_alex: after conn tweak + scale, error rate now 1.1% at 10m, customer reports dropping. continuing to monitor.

eng_jordan: confirm paused rollout stays paused. keeping feature flag off.

support_emily: status page updated and incident priority set to P1. Customers notified.

platform_oncall: initiating gradual traffic shift back to us-east-1 with canary weight 10% -> 50%.

sre_alex: observing canary - 10% no regression. increasing to 50%.

sre_alex: full rollback of the problematic routing config applied (was impacting connection reuse heuristics)..

ml_rachael: redis pool stabilized after tweak and pods restarted. no more 504s from that shard.

incident-bot: NOTE: Pageresolved?false — follow-ups required: write postmortem, evaluate connection pool defaults, review rollout gating.

sre_alex: marking primary mitigation complete. error rate steady at 0.6% last 5m, p95 210ms. handing off to on-call for post-incident cleanup and RCA.

platform_oncall: handing off to daytime SRE for long-term fixes. I'll keep the emergency cb with a 10m TTL.

support_emily: customer comms sent: temporary workaround deployed, monitoring ongoing. will update when RCA done.

eng_jordan: logging the paused rollout + rollback in changelog.

ml_rachael: will capture KV cache/redis connection traces and open a follow-up ticket to update defaults and add higher-res metrics.

sre_alex: thanks everyone. incident here is moving to "mitigated" — on-call shift will own RCA and timeline.

support_emily: :white_check_mark: thanks all.
summary: us-east-1 gateway 502/504 spike; circuit-breaker, scale, connection-pool tweaks, and routing rollback mitigated issue; customer impact limited to some checkout failures; follow-up RCA required
